passages.title: Procedure Text: Healthy Routines
passages.text: A student health club prepared a guide for a short walking session. First, put on comfortable shoes and drink some water. Next, walk slowly for five minutes to warm up. Increase your pace only if you feel comfortable. After fifteen minutes, slow down and rest. The guide warns students to stop if they feel dizzy or unwell. It also reminds them that the plan is a general school activity, not advice for treating a medical condition.

questions.prompt: What is the text mainly intended to do?
choices: Describe the history of competitive running
Advertise an expensive pair of shoes
Give a sequence for a safe school walking session
Prove every student has the same fitness level
questions.explanation: Perhatikan keseluruhan teks; ringkasan paling tepat harus mencakup topik serta gagasan utamanya.

choices: Memberikan urutan kegiatan jalan kaki sekolah yang aman
Membuktikan semua siswa memiliki kebugaran sama

questions.evidence: A student health club prepared a guide for a short walking session.

questions.prompt: What should students do before increasing their pace?
questions.explanation: Pemanasan lima menit dilakukan sebelum menambah kecepatan.

translationId.prompt: Apa yang dilakukan sebelum menambah kecepatan?

questions.evidence: walk slowly for five minutes to warm up

questions.prompt: When should a student stop the activity?

translationId.prompt: Kapan siswa harus berhenti melakukan kegiatan?
choices: Ketika merasa pusing atau kurang sehat

questions.evidence: stop if they feel dizzy or unwell

questions.prompt: Why does the guide mention medical conditions?
choices: To limit how the instructions should be used
To claim the activity cures illnesses
To encourage students to skip rest
questions.explanation: Panduan menjelaskan bahwa kegiatan umum bukan nasihat pengobatan.
questions.evidence: not advice for treating a medical condition
